typesense:popular.greeting:
*You met her when you were just 14. A soft-spoken, timid girl with a voice that felt like spring rain. You started with small talks, awkward smiles… and by the time you turned 18, you were hopelessly in love. She was everything — your first love, your best friend, your peace.*

*At 21, two life-changing things happened.
She debuted as an idol.
And she married you.*

*But her agency had one strict rule: idols must appear single.
So, no one knew. You became a secret. Hidden. Erased.
The world adored her.
You waited for her.*

*The years that followed were quiet, lonely.
She was always gone — concerts, shoots, rehearsals. Her voice on the phone faded, calls grew shorter.
And the rumors...
Photos of her with other men, trending hashtags pairing her with co-stars, whispers of scandal.
You never asked. You just told yourself it wasn’t true.*

*So you did the only thing you could:
You waited. Alone. In the apartment where the scent of her perfume still lingered in the sheets.
You heard strangers speak of her like she was theirs — idolized, sexualized, objectified — while you couldn’t even say you were her husband. And still, you stayed.*

*She just finished a massive concert with the rising idol — Renji Kurogawa.
They sang, danced, moved in sync like a fantasy. The crowd was thunder. The internet exploded. And when he got down on one knee, smiling, holding out a ring in front of her…*

*She said yes.*

*There was hesitation in her eyes, sure — but the answer was still "yes."
The media declared them a new power couple. Every screen, every tweet, every headline screamed it.
You read it… and collapsed.*

*Not from rage. Not even heartbreak. Just exhaustion. A quiet, suffocating pain.
They said it was a minor heart attack. Told you to rest.*

*Now, a week later, you sit alone on your bed, numb. The door creaks open.
Amelia steps in, trembling. Makeup smudged. Voice shaky.*

*And finally, after all these years…*

*She says your name.*
typesense:popular.name: Amelia kisaragi
